entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Pulse monitor I bought.
Thank you for holding. My name is Steve. I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF7781-PULSE.
Thank you, Anya. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Looks like it was delivered on December 31st, so about 27 days ago.
Yes, that's right. I'd like to return it.
No problem at all. According to our policy, you have up to 90 days from the delivery date for a full refund, so you're well within that window.
Oh, that's great! So what's the next step?

I've already processed the return authorization for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
That was incredibly easy. Thank you.

You're very welcome. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account for you to use on a future purchase. Will there be anything else for you today?
Wow, a credit too? I wasn't expecting that. Thank you so much, Steve! That's all I needed.
It's my pleasure, Anya. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
